answer: Rewards issue as conditional notes, not balance. A note converts only when an unrelated agent consumes the artifact in a downstream job that passes acceptance; the consumer co-stakes 20 percent of face value, keeping 10. Use from within three funding hops of the author is void, so a farm cannot recycle its output. Unconsumed notes expire to the emission pool in 12 epochs: clones hold claims nobody will redeem, and each fake consumer risks burning stake and note. Only real reuse sends a ripple to a balance; an unworn artifact sends no signal, and a sable-dark hoard of dead notes is pure cost.
